papers.title: The influence of accountability on procurement performance: a case study ministry of blue economy and fisheries Zanzibar
papers.authors: Manzi, Abdillah; Sama, Hamisi
papers.abstract: Accountability is a foundational pillar of procurement governance, yet quantitative evidence on how accountability mechanisms specifically shape procurement outcomes within individual government ministries in Zanzibar remains scarce. This study examined the influence of accountability on procurement performance at the Ministry of Blue Economy and Fisheries (MoBEF), Zanzibar. Guided by Institutional Theory and attached in a positivist research philosophy, study adopted a descriptive and explanatory quantitative design where a structured, five-point Likert-scale questionnaire was administered to 85 respondents drawn from a target population of 108 procurement officers, tender board members, finance officers, user department representatives, internal auditors, and registered suppliers, selected through stratified random sampling using Yamane’s (1967) formula. Data were analyzed descriptively and inferentially using IBM SPSS version 23, incorporating reliability testing, correlation, and multiple linear regressions. Descriptive results revealed that accountability practices were generally well established at MoBEF, with mean scores ranging from 3.90 to 4.12. Review and approval procedures and documentation practices attracted the strongest endorsement, while disciplinary enforcement for procurement irregularities recorded both the lowest mean (M = 3.90) and the greatest variability (SD = 0.89), indicating a structural enforcement gap within the Ministry’s accountability system. Multiple regression analysis confirmed that accountability significantly and positively predicted procurement performance (β = 0.27, SE = 0.07, t = 3.57, p = .001), alongside fairness (β = 0.31, p < .001) and transparency (β = 0.29, p = .002); the overall model was statistically significant (F(3, 81) = 28.45, p < .001, R² = 0.520). The null hypothesis was rejected. These findings confirm that while formal accountability structures are well established within MoBEF, inconsistent disciplinary enforcement limits their full effect on procurement performance. The study recommends strengthening audit follow-through, enforcing consistent sanctions for non-compliance, and institutionalizing structured monitoring systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以桑给巴尔蓝色经济与渔业部（MoBEF）为例，基于制度理论，采用描述性与解释性定量设计，通过问卷对85名采购相关人员调查，检验问责机制对采购绩效的影响。结果显示问责实践总体建立良好，但违规纪律执行得分最低且变异最大，存在结构性执行缺口。多元回归表明问责显著正向预测采购绩效（β=0.27, p=.001），公平性与透明度亦为显著预测因子（模型R²=0.520）。研究建议强化审计跟踪、统一违规惩戒并制度化监测体系。

papers.title: Influence of a thermohaline front on the trophic ecology of the small pelagic fish Lycengraulis grossidens (Clupeiformes: Engraulidae)
papers.authors: Marcilese, María Manuela; Parietti, Manuela; Temperoni, Brenda; Buratti, German Esteban; Buratti, Claudio César
papers.abstract: Abstract Lycengraulis grossidens is economically important for artisanal fisheries and prey of top predators in the Río de la Plata (RP) (SW Atlantic). In particular, Samborombón Bay (SB)—RAMSAR site and key marine summer feeding area for the species—is strongly affected by climate variability. Diet composition, feeding strategy and dietary shifts related to fish size and to an existing thermohaline front between two SB zones were determined in late austral summer (April). A high incidence of brackish/marine prey was hypothesized, varying ontogenetically and in relation with the front. Trophic incidence exceeded 90%. Neomysis americana (Mysidacea) dominated the diet, followed by decapod larvae, gastropods and teleosts. The feeding strategy was specialist at the population level for N. americana but generalist for other prey. Both nMDS and GLM analyses supported the hypothesis, as N. americana , copepods and gastropods were more consumed in North SB, while teleosts South SB, linked to the thermohaline front affecting prey distribution. Smaller individuals (<100 mm) consumed copepods and decapod larvae, whereas larger individuals (>150 mm) increasingly fed on N. americana and gastropods. Unlike previous studies reporting piscivory at larger sizes, SB specimens maintained a zooplankton‐based diet, with a strong preference for N. americana . Results highlight the species' trophic plasticity and the influence of environmental and ontogenetic factors. This study provides valuable new information on the trophic ecology of L. grossidens in marine waters after a gap of over 60 years, contributing to a better understanding of its trophic role in highly dynamic estuarine and coastal ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究分析了热盐锋对Samborombón湾小型中上层鱼类*Lycengraulis grossidens*摄食生态的影响，通过胃含物分析确定其食物组成、摄食策略及随鱼体大小和锋面位置的变化。结果显示该鱼种摄食发生率超过90%，以*Neomysis americana*为主，种群水平表现为专食性但整体为广食性；热盐锋通过影响猎物分布导致南北湾食物组成差异，且小型个体摄食桡足类和十足目幼体、大型个体更多摄食*N. americana*和腹足类。研究表明该鱼种在海洋环境中维持浮游动物食性并具有较强摄食可塑性，填补了60余年来其摄食生态的研究空白。

papers.title: Microbial contamination of fish production waste after processing in eco biocomposters
papers.authors: Khomenko, R. M.; Alexandrov, V. V.; Knysh, I. V.; Simeyko, A. V.
papers.abstract: Currently, the problem of processing various types of organic waste from agricultural and food production is becoming the most urgent, as they often have to be disposed of by paying for this service. At the same time, the cost of protein components of feed and, consequently, compound feeds is constantly increasing. In this regard, the development of new technologies and technical solutions for processing agricultural and food waste for possible use in animal feeding is becoming relevant. One of these technologies, which allows the production of animal feed products, is the biothermal processing of organic waste using special installations, for example, biothermal composters "ECO" produced by LLC Radian Proekt and JSC PK ECO. Technological solutions used in ECO biocomposters have made it possible to create a fully autonomous machine for the disposal of food and organic waste of various volumes. The article presents the results of a chemical analysis of the resulting compost after processing fish waste (adult rainbow trout) for compliance with certain qualitative indicators. In the conducted studies, it was found that the average mass of waste and bacteria (bio-mixture) loaded for processing at one time decreased by 16.1 times and amounted to 1,9 ± 0,2 kg, the moisture content was 1.9%, the mass fraction of water-soluble carbohydrates increased to 6,8%, the protein content increased to 10,5% compared with the initial product.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了生态生物堆肥机处理虹鳟成鱼加工废弃物后所得堆肥的化学与微生物质量，旨在探索鱼类加工废弃物的资源化利用途径。研究测定了堆肥前后物料质量、含水量、水溶性碳水化合物及蛋白质含量等指标。结果显示，单次处理物料（废弃物与菌剂混合物）平均质量降至1.9±0.2 kg（减少16.1倍），含水量为1.9%，水溶性碳水化合物升至6.8%，蛋白质含量升至10.5%。

papers.title: Long-Term Low- and Normal-Temperature Operation of Commercial Recirculating Aquaculture System Biofilters: Contrasting Microbial Communities and Predicted Nitrogen-Cycling Profiles
papers.authors: Jiang, Wenwen; Fu, Qi; Liu, Tingting; Li, Li; Wang, Guodong; Guo, Enmian
papers.abstract: Microorganisms in biofilters are essential to recirculating aquaculture systems (RASs). Low temperature is an important environmental stress influencing the performance of the biofilter in RASs. However, how the microorganisms in the biofilters respond to low temperature remains unclear. In this study, we compared the microbial communities of two commercial RAS biofilters operating under low- and normal-temperature regimes across four seasons. Both biofilters generally kept low ammonia and nitrite concentrations, although the low-temperature biofilter exhibited higher nitrite levels overall with a more pronounced seasonal increase. The low-temperature biofilter also exhibited lower bacterial diversity, fewer detected taxa, and substantial shifts in community composition. The microbial communities were strongly associated with TOC, alkalinity, and inorganic nitrogen. Its co-occurrence network was smaller and more centralized, with greater clustering and shorter average path lengths, indicating highly concentrated microbial associations. Predicted nitrogen-cycle profiles also differed between the two biofilters. The predicted nitrification profile did not differ significantly, whereas the predicted denitrification profile was lower in the low-temperature biofilter. These findings indicate that the two commercial systems harbored distinctly different microbial communities, reflecting differences in specific processes. Collectively, mature RAS biofilters sustained ammonia and nitrite removal despite substantial community simplification, whereas individual predicted nitrogen-cycling processes exhibited distinct predicted patterns under the two operating regimes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了两套商业RAS生物滤器在低温与常温运行下四个季节的微生物群落差异。低温滤器亚硝酸盐水平更高且季节波动更明显，细菌多样性较低、检出类群更少，群落组成变化显著，并与TOC、碱度和无机氮密切相关；其共现网络更小、更集中。预测氮循环中硝化谱无显著差异，但低温滤器反硝化谱较低。结果表明成熟RAS生物滤器在群落显著简化的条件下仍能维持氨和亚硝酸盐去除，但各氮循环过程在两种运行模式下呈现不同预测格局。

papers.title: Labeling and accounting of salmon species aquaculture facilities in cage farming in the context of modern regulatory and legal regulation in the Russian Federation and integration into veterinary information systems
papers.authors: Akimova, N. S.; Markov, T. I.
papers.abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the current state of the system of labeling and accounting of salmon aquaculture facilities in cage farming. The regulatory framework for regulating this area in the Russian Federation is being considered, including Federal Law No. 148-FZ "On Aquaculture (Fish Farming)", Decree of the Government of the Russian Federation No. 550 "On Approval of the List of Animal Species Subject to Labeling and Accounting" and EAEU Technical Regulation 040/2016 "On the Safety of Fish and Fish Products". The practical aspects of the introduction of fish identification systems using group and individual labeling methods, the specifics of the use of product traceability technologies are analyzed. The key problems of the existing accounting system have been identified, from the technological difficulties of installing microchips to insufficient integration of information systems. The necessity of modernizing labeling approaches is substantiated, taking into account the biological characteristics of salmon and the technological conditions of cage cultivation. The directions of improving the regulatory framework and practical accounting mechanisms for aquaculture facilities are proposed.
papers.summary_cn: 该文分析俄罗斯网箱养殖鲑科鱼类设施的标签与追溯体系现状，梳理了联邦法律第148-FZ号、政府令第550号及EAEU技术法规040/2016等监管框架。研究评估了群体与个体标记方法及产品追溯技术的实践应用，识别出从微芯片植入的技术难点到信息系统整合不足等关键问题。文章论证了结合鲑鱼生物学特性与网箱养殖技术条件现代化标签方法的必要性，并提出完善法规框架与核算机制的方向。

papers.title: Deep-Learning-Assisted Discovery of Marine Antimicrobial Peptides: A Roadmap Integrating Omics Mining, Structure-Guided Diffusion Design, and Sustainable Aquaculture Translation
papers.authors: Liu, Bo; Liu, Hanjing; Jia, Yunna; He, Jie; Wang, Ye; Jiang, Haiyan; Xue, Zhiyang; Guo, Shuqi; Zhu, Yuanquan; Kong, Lingcong
papers.abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) offer diverse antibacterial mechanisms, but candidate generation alone does not resolve the linked demands of potency, host safety, stability, manufacturability, and application-specific exposure. This review presents a roadmap that integrates two complementary computational routes for marine AMP discovery. De novo generation expands sequence space, whereas omics mining preserves biological provenance and enables recovery of encoded or encrypted peptides from marine organisms and microbiomes. Structure-guided diffusion is positioned as a selective third route when a defined target, motif, or stable structural template is available, rather than as a universal replacement for sequence-based AMP models. We further examine aquaculture as a translational setting in which efficacy must be evaluated together with salt and feed tolerance, environmental fate, tissue residues, resistance risk, and export-related requirements. Current evidence remains limited at the direct intersection of marine provenance and deep learning, particularly for target-conditioned structural design. We therefore propose an evidence-based workflow that links marine sequence resources, model selection, matched experimental validation, and application-specific deployment. This framework is intended to move marine AMP research from candidate prediction toward reproducible and testable translation.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述提出整合组学挖掘与深度学习生成的海源抗菌肽（AMP）发现路线图：de novo生成扩展序列空间，omics mining保留生物来源并回收编码/加密肽，结构引导扩散仅在明确靶标或结构模板时作为选择性第三条路线。水产养殖被作为转化场景，需同时评估盐度与饲料耐受性、环境归趋、组织残留及耐药风险。当前海源来源与深度学习直接交叉的证据有限，作者据此提出连接海洋序列资源、模型选择、匹配实验验证与应用部署的循证工作流。

papers.title: Recombinase Polymerase Amplification Combined With the Programmable Nuclease Pf Ago for Rapid Detection of Perkinsus olseni in Shellfish
papers.authors: Wang, Pei; Qin, Yuxin; Huang, Yidan; Ren, Yuxuan; Lin, Yan; Wu, Huiling; Zhu, Huabiao; Ding, Hong; Li, Yanan; Gao, Song
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Perkinsus olseni is a major pathogenic parasite that threatens shellfish aquaculture and can trigger mass mortality and considerable economic losses. Conventional culture‐based assays and PCR‐based detection protocols for P. olseni recommended by the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) involve long assay durations and heavy dependence on sophisticated instruments, making them unsuitable for on‐site rapid screening. To establish a simple, rapid and highly sensitive detection method for early warning of P. olseni at aquaculture sites, this study integrated isothermal recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA) with the specific‐recognition capacity of Pf Ago nuclease to construct an RPA‐ Pf Ago detection assay. The assay achieved favourable specificity with a limit of detection as low as 30 copies. Its practical applicability was validated using 55 real‐world shellfish samples. Performing at constant temperatures, the RPA‐ Pf Ago detection assay features a simple procedure and short turnaround time, effectively addressing the drawbacks of conventional detection approaches. This assay is suitable for shellfish seed quarantine and routine pathogen surveillance in shellfish farms, and provides solid support for the early prevention and control of perkinsosis caused by P. olseni .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对威胁贝类养殖的致病性寄生虫Perkinsus olseni，将等温重组酶聚合酶扩增（RPA）与Pf Ago核酸酶的特异性识别能力相结合，构建了RPA-Pf Ago快速检测方法。该方法特异性良好，检测限低至30拷贝，并经55份实际贝类样品验证了实用性。该检测在恒温下操作简便、周转时间短，适用于贝类苗种检疫和养殖场常规病原监测，为perkinsosis的早期防控提供支持。

papers.title: Energetic costs of catch and release angling in B rook T rout ( S alvelinus fontinalis ) at two temperatures
papers.authors: Hodgson, Ryan Y.; Holder, Peter E.; Nowell, Liane B.; Cooke, Steven J.; Brownscombe, Jacob W.
papers.abstract: Abstract Catch and release (C&R) angling is a common practice in recreational fisheries, which can involve a range of acute stressors for fish that lead to physiological and behavioural impairments. Following a C&R event, energy is expended to fuel recovery, while a cessation in feeding can limit energy intake. While the physiological and behavioural consequences of C&R have been extensively studied, the extent of the bioenergetic impacts has rarely been characterized. This study aimed to assess the energetic impacts of C&R stressors on Brook Trout ( Salvelinus fontinalis )—a cold‐water salmonid sensitive to temperature perturbations and air exposure. Adult Brook Trout were subjected to simulated angling events (i.e. 30s chase, 30s chase and 10s air exposure) or served as controls at 10°C and 15°C. Respirometry was used to measure energy expenditure through excess post‐exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), while a feeding experiment determined the time to return to feeding. Energy expenditure and reductions in energy consumption were incorporated into a bioenergetics model to predict growth outcomes following captures (i.e. 1, 3, 5) over 30 days. The stressors simulated here resulted in a maximum growth deviation of 4.1% (95% CI [2.8–6.5]) after a single capture and 21.0% (95% CI [14.6–33.4]) after five captures. Across temperatures, Brook Trout experienced higher peak metabolic rates at 15°C, but rapid recovery resulted in similar energetic costs of recovery to 10°C. However, our bioenergetic simulations revealed that prolonged (24 h) elevated daily temperature (15°C) occupancy raised metabolic energy expenditure negating the benefits of a faster resumption of feeding. Nevertheless, the moderate simulated C&R stressors tested here within the optimal temperature range of Brook Trout resulted in relatively small energetic consequences, even with numerous simulated captures. Future research should explore the bioenergetic effects of more intense (but still reasonably common) C&R stressors, including longer air exposure periods, hooking injuries and temperature extremes.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在量化模拟捕获放流（C&R）应激对溪红点鲑（Brook Trout, Salvelinus fontinalis）的能量学影响。成鱼在10°C和15°C下接受模拟钓捕处理（30秒追逐、30秒追逐+10秒暴露空气）或作为对照，通过呼吸测定法测定运动后过量耗氧（EPOC），并结合摄食恢复实验将能量消耗与摄食减少纳入生物能量学模型预测30天生长。结果显示，单次捕获后最大生长偏差为4.1%，五次捕获后达21.0%；15°C下峰值代谢率更高但恢复迅速，能量恢复成本与10°C相似，然而持续24小时处于15°C会因代谢能耗增加而抵消摄食恢复加快的收益。总体而言，在溪红点鲑适宜温度范围内，中等强度的C&R应激即使多次捕获也仅产生较小的能量学后果，未来需关注更强烈应激源（如长时间暴露空气、钩伤及极端温度）的影响。

papers.title: Partitioning patterns of fish and sea urchin herbivory from tropical to temperate reefs
papers.authors: Rose, Matthew; Ruiz-Ruiz, Paula A.; Tebbett, Sterling B.; Jones, Tyson R.; Herrera-Fuchs, Yann; Denis-Roy, Lara; L. Butler, Claire; Ling, Scott D.
papers.abstract: Abstract Herbivory can structure vegetation and affect the states of sunlit ecosystems. On shallow tropical and temperate reefs, herbivory can inhibit macroalgal dominance and promote turf-dominated benthic states. However, standardised comparisons of tropical and temperate herbivory are primarily focussed on fish, leaving the relative contributions of sea urchins poorly understood. Here, we examined thermal realm (tropical vs temperate) and depth (2, 5, 8 and 12-m) effects on relative herbivory patterns and herbivore distributions, using standardised macroalgal assays (N = 1,340) and underwater visual surveys (N = 67 surveys) at 49 sites across six locations spanning approximately 29° of latitude in eastern Australia. Assays were deployed to partition the relative intensity of herbivory using two partitioning treatments: 1) assays were suspended above the benthos allowing only fish consumption (water-column herbivory), and 2) assays were laid flat on the benthos enabling fish and urchin consumption (benthic herbivory). Assay results showed higher fish herbivory on tropical reefs than on temperate reefs, whereas relative benthic herbivory did not differ between thermal realms. Variation in assay consumption across depth was limited. Results from assays and surveys aligned, with higher herbivorous fish abundance on tropical reefs and higher urchin abundance on temperate reefs. Relative patterns in fish and urchin herbivory between thermal realms underscores differences in how herbivory occurs and where in the water-column it predominates, highlighting a key axis of variation for tropicalizing reefs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过标准化大型海藻测定（N=1,340）和水下视觉调查（N=67），在澳大利亚东部跨越约29°纬度的49个站点比较了热带与温带礁区鱼类和海胆的植食性模式及其分布。测定采用两种处理分离水体层（仅鱼类摄食）和底栖（鱼类与海胆共同摄食）植食强度。结果显示热带礁鱼类植食强度高于温带礁，而底栖植食强度在两热域间无差异；测定与调查结果一致，热带礁植食性鱼类丰度更高，温带礁海胆丰度更高。

papers.title: Image-Based Asymmetric Feature Fusion Using EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNetV3Large for Multi-Class Fish Disease Classification<b></b>
papers.authors: Helmud, Ellya; Kiswanto
papers.journal: Journal of Information Systems and Informatics
papers.abstract: This study proposes an asymmetric hybrid feature-fusion network that combines EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNetV3Large in parallel for multi-class classification of eight fish disease categories. The approach is designed to exploit the complementary feature-learning capabilities of both lightweight convolutional neural network architectures while maintaining computational efficiency for potential diagnostic applications. The model was evaluated on a public dataset of 2,400 digital images, divided into training, validation, and test sets using an 80:10:10 ratio. The held-out test set contained 240 unseen images, with 30 images representing each class. As all data partitions originated from the same dataset, the evaluation reflects performance on the same source distribution rather than external generalization. The proposed architecture fuses spatial feature representations through parallel Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Global Max Pooling (GMP) layers. Training followed a progressive two-phase strategy comprising top-layer warm-up and micro deep fine-tuning with a learning rate of \(10^{-5}\) and label smoothing. Experimental results achieved a validation accuracy of 0.9667 with a loss of 0.5843, and a test accuracy of 0.9833 with a loss of 0.5375 and a macro-average ROC-AUC of 0.9998. On an NVIDIA RTX 3080 GPU, the model recorded an average inference time of 8.61 ms per image, equivalent to 116.18 FPS. Further evaluation using external farm datasets and low-power edge devices is required before real-world deployment.
papers.summary_cn: 提出一种并行融合EfficientNet-B0与MobileNetV3Large的非对称混合特征融合网络，用于八类鱼病图像分类，通过GAP与GMP融合空间特征并采用两阶段渐进训练策略。在2,400张公开图像（8:1:1划分）上，验证集准确率0.9667、测试集准确率0.9833，macro-average ROC-AUC达0.9998，单图推理耗时8.61 ms（116.18 FPS）。作者指出评估限于同源数据分布，需在外部养殖场数据集与低功耗边缘设备上进一步验证方可实际部署。

papers.title:
fishFingers: Prioritization
of High-Resolution Mass
Spectrometry Features by Prediction of Bioconcentration Factors in
Fish Species
papers.authors: Szabo, Drew; MacOscar, Kian; Plaisted, Katie; McGarrigle, Marie; Boxall, Alistair B. A.; Mosely, Jackie A.
papers.abstract: Abstract The number of novel entities produced around the world exceeds our capacity to evaluate the risk of each chemical under traditional frameworks. Detecting, prioritizing, and identifying thousands of chemicals present in the environment is a challenge to understanding this planetary boundary. Machine learning has demonstrated quick and accurate predictions for ecotoxicological end points for chemicals with structural fingerprints derived from high-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS). This study provides a new nontargeted screening strategy to prioritize HRMS features by the prediction of bioconcentration factors (BCF) without a priori structural annotation. An XGBoost model was trained on a database with structural fingerprints from 1285 unique substances and log10 BCF measurements from 111 species of fish. Validation was performed using structural fingerprints derived from high-quality tandem mass spectrometry (MS2), with RMSE = 1.02, MAE = 0.81, and ρ = 0.50, demonstrating its capability in predicting log10 BCF and to rank HRMS features by predicted bioconcentration from a wide chemical space. Variations in BCF were observed in species such as common carp (Cyprinus carpio), which exhibits lower average BCF compared with zebrafish (Danio rerio). Halogenation, aliphatic and aromatic carbon, and heteroatomaticity were among the most important structural fingerprints for BCF. The model and package are available from https://github.com/drewszabo/fishFingers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究开发了fishFingers工具，利用XGBoost模型基于高分辨率质谱（HRMS）结构指纹预测鱼类生物富集因子（BCF），无需先验结构注释即可对HRMS特征进行优先级排序。模型在1285种物质和111种鱼类的数据上训练，验证结果显示RMSE=1.02、MAE=0.81、ρ=0.50。研究发现鲤鱼（Cyprinus carpio）的平均BCF低于斑马鱼（Danio rerio），卤化、脂肪族和芳香族碳及杂芳香性是最重要的结构指纹特征。

papers.title: Utilization of Fish Waste Flour as a Substitute for Fish Meal on the Growth Rate and Survival of Catfish (Clarias sp.)
papers.authors: Kaka Avinsha, Rezha; Wisnu Ariyati, Restiana; Vivi Endar Herawati, Vivi Endar Herawati
papers.abstract: Catfish (Clarias sp.) is a type of fish that is relatively easy to cultivate and has relatively fast growth. The quality and quantity of raw materials used to make feed must be considered to enhance the development of catfish. One of the nutrients in the feed needed by catfish is protein. Catfish utilize protein for the growth process. One alternative protein source to fish meal is fish waste meal. Fish waste meal contains a protein content of 46.02% and has a lysine amino acid profile content of 3.68%. This research aims to determine the effect of substituting fish waste flour for fish flour in feed on the growth performance of catfish. This study employed an experimental method with a completely randomized design (CRD) consisting of 5 treatments and 3 replications. The treatments tested were treatment A (40% fish waste flour), B (30% fish waste flour), C (20% fish waste flour), D (10% fish waste flour), and E (0% fish waste flour). The test fish used were Sangkuriang catfish weighing 2.85-3.15 grams and stocking density of 10 per container. The catfish was reared in an aquarium with a water volume of 35 liters. Maintenance was carried out for 42 days with feeding three times a day at 08:00, 12:00, and 16:00. The research results indicate that substituting fish meal with fish waste flour significantly affects (P<0.05) TFC, FUE, FCR, SGR, and absolute weight. The best dose of fish meal substitution with fish waste flour is treatment B (30% substitution of fish waste flour), which can produce TPW of 191.61±1.910 grams; FUE of 61.74±0.441 % FCR of 1.62±0.012; SGR of 3.87±0.043% per day; and absolute weight of 11.98±0.193 grams.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在探究以鱼废弃物粉替代鱼粉对鲶鱼（Clarias sp.）生长性能的影响。试验采用完全随机设计，设5个替代水平（0%、10%、20%、30%、40%），养殖42天。结果表明，替代显著影响总摄食量、饲料利用效率、FCR、SGR和绝对增重，其中30%替代组表现最佳（绝对增重11.98±0.193 g，SGR 3.87%/天，FCR 1.62）。鱼废弃物粉可有效替代鱼粉用于鲶鱼配合饲料。

papers.title: Experimental evaluation of habitat preferences of invasive crayfish species in Europe in context of co-invasions
papers.authors: Plichta, Zuzanna; Maciaszek, Rafał; Augustyniak, Mateusz; Kakareko, Tomasz; Jermacz, Łukasz; Kobak, Jarosław
papers.abstract: Abstract Biological invasions commonly occur in series, leading to new interactions between multiple invaders in novel habitats. Their coexistence or competitive exclusion depends on the width and overlap of their habitat preferences. We evaluated the habitat preferences of North American crayfishes invasive in Europe: Faxonius limosus ( FL ), Procambarus clarkii ( PC ) and Procambarus virginalis ( PV ), to check their selectivity for substratum grain sizes, shelter sizes, and shells of various bivalve species as shelters. All the species exhibited overlapping grain size preferences (diameter: 2 mm), PV being the least selective (preference extending to 5 mm). FL selected smaller shelters than PC . FL and PC preferred shells of the alien Sinanodonta woodiana over native unionid mussels, whereas PV was non-selective for unionid shells. All species avoided the smaller Corbicula shells. Altogether, in our study, FL was the most, whereas PV the least selective, and PC the most explorative. The high overlap of habitat preferences and low probability of habitat partitioning suggests that the coexistence of these crayfishes will be temporary, and FL is likely to get displaced by new Procambarus invaders, P. clarkii being more explorative and aggressive, P. virginalis being less selective.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过实验评估了三种入侵欧洲的北美螯虾——Faxonius limosus（FL）、Procambarus clarkii（PC）和Procambarus virginalis（PV）——在底质粒径、庇护所尺寸及双壳类贝壳作为庇护所方面的栖息地偏好，以探讨多重入侵情境下的共存机制。结果显示三种螯虾的粒径偏好高度重叠（约2 mm），PV选择性最低（偏好延伸至5 mm）；FL偏好较小庇护所；FL和PC偏好外来种Sinanodonta woodiana贝壳而非本土unionid贝类，PV则无选择性；所有种均回避较小的Corbicula贝壳。总体上FL选择性最强、PV最弱、PC探索性最强，栖息地偏好高度重叠且栖息地分割概率低，表明三者共存可能是暂时的，FL likely将被新的Procambarus入侵者取代。

papers.title: Quantifying surgeonfish functions in coral reef sediment dynamics: an ecological and evolutionary perspective
papers.authors: Ng, Isabelle; Tebbett, Sterling B.; Bellwood, David R.; Gahan, James; Strugnell, Jan M.; Siqueira, Alexandre C.

papers.title: Variable dissolved organic carbon trends in the tributaries of the St. Lawrence River driven by natural geographic features and human activities
papers.authors: Dormoy-Boulanger, Jade; Lapierre, Jean-François; Guillemette, François
papers.abstract: Over the past decades, dissolved organic carbon (DOC) concentrations in boreal rivers have increased broadly. At the regional scale, however, the magnitude of these trends varies, likely reflecting differences in natural and anthropogenic catchment features that remain poorly understood. Here we examined long-term DOC trends data from 89 stations located on 54 tributaries of the St. Lawrence River (Qc, Canada) over 35 years, assessing DOC changes among catchments with contrasting natural characteristics and land-use patterns. We observed a significant increase in DOC in 46 stations (0.08–1.54% per year), and a significant decrease in 19 stations (−0.25 to −1.59% per year). When considering climatic variables and land cover features, the proportion of forested area within the watershed emerged as the most significant factor; DOC tended to increase at forest cover >60% and to be stable or decrease at forest cover <60%. Watershed slope, water area, and annual mean precipitation were also significantly associated with DOC changes. This study emphasizes the importance of accounting for land-use differences when interpreting regional patterns of river DOC trends.
papers.summary_cn: 基于加拿大圣劳伦斯河54条支流89个站点35年的长期数据，分析了溶解有机碳（DOC）浓度的变化趋势及其与流域自然特征和土地利用的关系。结果显示46个站点DOC显著上升（0.08–1.54%/年），19个站点显著下降（−0.25至−1.59%/年）。森林覆盖率是最重要的影响因素：覆盖率>60%的流域DOC趋于上升，<60%的流域趋于稳定或下降；流域坡度、水域面积和年均降水量也与DOC变化显著相关。研究强调在解释区域河流DOC趋势时需考虑土地利用差异。

papers.title: An integrated approach to estimating the effective sampling area of baited underwater camera traps
papers.authors: Goldstein, Benjamin R.; Pacifici, Krishna; Buckel, Jeffrey A.; Bacheler, Nathan M.; Schliep, Erin M; Reich, Brian J; Shertzer, Kyle W.; Patterson, William F.; Tarnecki, Joseph H; Hostetter, Nathan J
papers.abstract: Baited remote underwater video (BRUV) surveys are increasingly used to monitor fish, but estimating absolute abundance remains challenging because effective sampling areas (ESA) are unknown. We present an approach to estimate ESAs using an unmarked spatial capture-recapture (USCR) framework where observed counts arise from fish movement and space use. The model integrates telemetry data on movement and counts from independent remotely operated vehicle surveys. We applied this method to red snapper (Lutjanus campechanus) at two sites in the southeastern United States. At Chicken Rock, North Carolina, estimated ESAs were 8,806-10,532 m^2, consistent with estimates from previous studies and telemetry data. At Turtle Mound, Florida, estimated ESAs were unrealistically large (230,129-444,977 m^2), with low estimated abundance (241-528). Poor performance at Turtle Mound likely resulted from wide camera spacing and limited information on the spatial distribution of individuals from telemetry data. Our results demonstrate the potential of USCR models to estimate fish density, absolute abundance, and BRUV ESAs, while emphasizing the sensitivity of model performance to camera placement and robust auxiliary data in heterogeneous systems.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究旨在解决baited remote underwater video（BRUV）调查中有效采样面积（ESA）未知、难以估算绝对丰度的问题，提出基于未标记空间捕获-再捕获（USCR）框架的ESA估算方法，整合遥测运动数据与ROV调查计数。在美国东南部两个站点应用于红鲷（Lutjanus campechanus）：北卡罗来纳Chicken Rock估算ESA为8,806–10,532 m²，与既往研究和遥测数据一致；佛罗里达Turtle Mound估算ESA异常偏大（230,129–444,977 m²）且丰度偏低（241–528），可能源于相机间距过大及遥测空间分布信息不足。结果表明USCR模型在估算鱼类密度、绝对丰度和BRUV ESA方面具有潜力，但模型表现对相机布设和异质系统中的辅助数据质量高度敏感。

papers.title: Forecasting Annual Capture Fisheries Production in Somalia Using ARIMA Models
papers.authors: Ahmed Mohamed, Mohiadin; Rooble Halane, Dhaqane; Omar Sabrie, Hassan
papers.journal: Journal of Ocean and Coastal Economics
papers.abstract: The study aims to forecast the production of Somalia's capture fisheries for the five years that follow, from 2024 to 2028, using the Box-Jenkins method and employing in-sample data spanning 50 years, from 1974 to 2023. Among the alternative models, ARIMA (1,1,1) was determined by the study to be the most suitable. The study obtained the data from World Bank development indicators (WDI) for the period between 1975 and 2023. According to the prediction's findings, the nation's capture fishing output will drop by roughly 1475 metric tons over the course of the following five years. The model was found to be white noise in the diagnostics, the moving average (MA) and autoregressive (AR) components were covariance stationary, and a rolling window test within a 95% confidence interval revealed the model's stability. The study suggests the Somali government should develop sustainable fishing strategies, standardize fish quality, strengthen oversight mechanisms, modernize fishing methods, and provide advanced training to fishermen. These measures can attract foreign investment and boost economic growth by promoting sustainable fishing practice.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究旨在利用Box-Jenkins方法和1974–2023年共50年的样本内数据，预测索马里2024–2028年五年间的捕捞渔业产量。研究确定ARIMA(1,1,1)为最适模型，诊断显示模型为白噪声、AR与MA分量协方差平稳，滚动窗口检验在95%置信区间内验证了模型稳定性。预测结果表明该国捕捞渔业产量在未来五年将下降约1475公吨。研究建议索马里政府制定可持续捕捞策略、规范鱼品质量、强化监管机制、推进捕捞方式现代化并为渔民提供高级培训，以吸引外资并促进经济增长。

papers.title: Genetic Architecture of Body Weight Variation and GWAS-Informed Genomic Selection in Formulated Diet-Adapted Mandarin Fish (Siniperca chuatsi)
papers.authors: Geng, Chenfan; Song, Hailiang; Xia, Yinglan; Zhang, Xin; Li, Shuisheng; Liu, Shuang; Teng, Jinmeng; Zhang, Yong; Hu, Hongxia
papers.abstract: Large variation in body weight poses a major challenge to the development and industrialization of formulated-feed aquaculture in Siniperca chuatsi. Breeding varieties that combine formulated-diet adaptation, rapid growth, and uniform body weight is therefore important for improving production efficiency. However, the genetic architecture of body weight and optimal genomic selection (GS) strategies remain poorly understood. Here, whole-genome resequencing was performed on 522 formulated-diet-adapted individuals. Genome-wide association study (GWAS) identified 21 significant loci, with candidate genes associated with lipid metabolism, endocrine regulation, and neuroendocrine signaling. Genomic prediction was evaluated using genome-wide single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) and GWAS-prioritized SNP panels with Bayesian and machine-learning models. Prediction accuracy increased with marker number and generally plateaued at approximately 30,000 SNPs. Random forest using GWAS-prioritized markers achieved the highest accuracy, improving prediction accuracy by 4.8% over genome-wide genomic best linear unbiased prediction (GBLUP) while using fewer markers. These findings demonstrate the potential of GWAS-informed marker prioritization to reduce marker requirements and improve GS efficiency for body weight in formulated-diet-adapted S. chuatsi.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对饲料驯化鳜（Siniperca chuatsi）体重变异大、制约配合饲料养殖产业化的问题，对522尾饲料驯化个体进行全基因组重测序，通过GWAS鉴定出21个显著位点，候选基因涉及脂质代谢、内分泌调控及神经内分泌信号通路。采用全基因组SNP及GWAS优先SNP面板结合贝叶斯与机器学习模型评估基因组选择（GS）预测准确性，发现预测准确性随标记数增加而提升并在约3万个SNP时趋于平台。基于GWAS优先标记的随机森林模型准确性最高，较全基因组GBLUP提升4.8%且使用标记更少，表明GWAS-informed标记优先策略可降低标记需求并提高饲料驯化鳜体重GS效率。

papers.title: First Report of Tenacibaculum maritimum Infection in Grouper ( Epinephelus spp.) Aquaculture in Taiwan
papers.authors: Wu, Shang‐Ting; Hsieh, Chia‐Yu
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Between April 2024 and 2025, six independent outbreaks of ulcerative skin disease occurred in cultured groupers ( Epinephelus spp.) across southern Taiwan and Penghu County during winter‐to‐spring seasonal transitions at water temperatures ranging from 19°C to 24°C. Affected fish presented with extensive epidermal erosion and deep dermal ulceration on the operculum, lateral trunk and caudal peduncle regions. Histopathology revealed marked integumentary breakdown characterised by epithelial sloughing, deep dermal necrosis and dense basophilic mats of filamentous bacteria tracking along necrotic subcutaneous myofibres. Wet‐mount microscopy and Gram‐stained lesion smears consistently revealed sheets of long, slender, Gram‐negative rods across all cases ( n = 18). Eighteen representative isolates exhibiting pale‐yellow, flat, adherent colonies with irregular margins were recovered on Marine Agar formulated with natural seawater (salinity 30‰–35‰). Species‐specific PCR and near‐full‐length 16S rRNA gene sequencing (1505 bp; > 99.5% identity to the type strain NCIMB 2154 T ) confirmed the aetiology to be Tenacibaculum maritimum . Physiological profiling revealed a narrow salinity tolerance window (30‰–45‰), in contrast to the broader range of classic temperate strains (10‰–35‰). This study represents the first definitive isolation and molecular/physiological characterisation of T. maritimum in farmed groupers in Taiwan, expanding its host spectrum and geographical range into subtropical mariculture zones.
papers.summary_cn: 2024年4月至2025年间，台湾南部及澎湖县养殖石斑鱼（Epinephelus spp.）在冬春交替、水温19–24°C条件下发生6起独立溃疡性皮肤病暴发，病灶表现为表皮广泛糜烂及真皮深层溃疡，组织病理显示上皮脱落、真皮坏死及丝状细菌沿坏死皮下肌纤维分布。通过特异性PCR及16S rRNA基因测序（与模式菌株NCIMB 2154^T同源性>99.5%）确认病原为Tenacibaculum maritimum，生理 profiling 显示其耐盐窗口较窄（30‰–45‰），有别于温带经典菌株（10‰–35‰）。本研究首次在台湾养殖石斑鱼中分离并完成T. maritimum的分子与生理学鉴定，扩展了该病原的宿主谱及地理分布至亚热带海水养殖区。

papers.title: Neuropeptide Regulation of Aquaporin Intracellular Trafficking in Marine Teleost Rectal Enterocytes
papers.authors: Chauvigné, François; Toala-Franco, Daniel; Rey-Alfonso, Àngel; Catalán-García, Marc; Finn, Roderick Nigel; Cerdà, Joan
papers.abstract: In marine teleosts, the neuroendocrine regulation of aquaporin intracellular trafficking in osmoregulatory organs such as the intestinal rectum remains underexplored. By using paralog-specific antibodies, here we determined the subcellular localization of seven aquaporin and aquaglyceroporin paralogs in the rectal enterocytes of the marine teleost gilthead seabream (Sparus aurata) and investigated the neuropeptinergic effects of arginine vasopressin (Avp) and oxytocin (Oxt) on channel trafficking. The data reveal that Aqp1aa, -1ab2 and -3a are mainly localized in the cytoplasm and basolateral membranes of the enterocytes, while Aqp1ab1, -10bb and -14 are cytoplasmatic and also present in the apical plasma membrane microvilli. In contrast, Aqp0a localizes in the enterocyte subapical cytoplasm. Treatment of rectal explants with Avp in vitro increases the targeting of Aqp1ab1, -1ab2, -10bb and -14, but not of Aqp0a, -1aa and -3a, to the enterocyte apical microvilli, which involves protein kinase A (PKA)-mediated phosphorylation of the channel subdomains. In addition, we find that the differential interaction of the Aqp1ab-type paralogs with teleost-specific 14-3-3ζ-like binding proteins is associated with the trafficking of the channels to the apical microvilli membranes. Conversely, Oxt treatment does not affect the subcellular distribution of any of the investigated aquaporins, except Aqp14, which is internalized in response to the neuropeptide by a partially independent protein kinase C pathway. These data suggest that Avp-PKA signaling controls plasma membrane trafficking of several seabream rectal aquaporins, possibly to facilitate water and solute fluxes across the enterocyte membrane.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究探究了神经内分泌因子对海水硬骨鱼直肠肠上皮细胞中aquaporin胞内转运的调控机制。利用旁系同源特异性抗体，研究确定了七种aquaporin/aquaglyceroporin在gilthead seabream（Sparus aurata）直肠肠上皮细胞中的亚细胞定位，并检测了arginine vasopressin（Avp）和oxytocin（Oxt）对通道转运的影响。结果显示，Avp通过PKA介导的磷酸化促进Aqp1ab1、-1ab2、-10bb和-14向肠上皮细胞顶端微绒毛的靶向转运，且Aqp1ab型旁系同源物与14-3-3ζ样结合蛋白的差异互作参与该过程；而Oxt仅引起Aqp14的内化。结果表明Avp-PKA信号通路调控多种海鲷直肠aquaporin的质膜转运，可能有助于跨肠上皮细胞膜的水和溶质通量。

papers.title: Effects of Pretreatment on the Isotopic Composition of Structural Carbonate in Ray‐Finned Fish Teeth
papers.authors: Furuya, Toshikazu; Yokouchi, Kazuki; Okumura, Taiga; Shirai, Kotaro
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Rationale The carbon and oxygen stable isotope ratios (δ 13 C and δ 18 O) of carbonate contained in fish tooth dentin have the potential to offer insights into environmental and ecological conditions, making them promising targets for analysis in fossil specimens. However, the tooth dentin of extant specimens contains significant amounts of organic matter that can decompose or produce gases that interfere with isotope measurements. Therefore, a well‐developed pretreatment protocol for removing organic components prior to isotopic analysis is essential. Methods In this study, we developed pretreatment methods for removing organic matter to enable the isotopic analysis of structural carbonates in tooth dentin. Using teeth of the half‐smooth golden pufferfish ( Lagocephalus spadiceus ) as specimens, we applied a total of eight physical and chemical pretreatment protocols and evaluated their effects on carbonate isotopic composition. Results Treatments with neutral or alkaline pancreatin solutions effectively removed organic matter without altering the δ 13 C values of the carbonate. In contrast, no pretreatment method was identified that kept δ 18 O values entirely unaffected. However, treatment with the neutral pancreatin solution resulted in sufficient removal of organic matter and only minimal, consistent changes in δ 18 O. Conclusions Treatments with neutral or alkaline pancreatin solutions are recommended for the analysis of δ 13 C in carbonate within dentin. Although no method for ideal organic matter removal without changing δ 18 O values was identified, treatment with neutral pancreatin solution is recommended as the second‐best option. Because of the small and consistent change in δ 18 O, it is possible to correct for δ 18 O alterations induced by pretreatment.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在建立鱼牙本质结构碳酸盐稳定同位素分析前的有机质去除预处理方案。以半滑金河豚（Lagocephalus spadiceus）牙齿为材料，测试了8种物理和化学预处理流程对碳酸盐δ13C和δ18O组成的影响。中性和碱性胰蛋白酶溶液可有效去除有机质且不改变δ13C值，但所有方法均无法完全避免δ18O变化；中性胰蛋白酶处理引起的δ18O变化最小且一致，可通过校正消除。推荐中性或碱性胰蛋白酶处理用于牙本质碳酸盐δ13C分析，中性胰蛋白酶处理作为δ18O分析次优选择。

papers.title: Promoting sustainable fishing: from the perspective of Fisheries Funding Mechanism under the Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies
papers.authors: Bai, Jiayu; Guo, Muyun; Zhao, Min
papers.abstract: With widespread depletion of the world’s marine resources, the sustainable fishing has risen more and more concern on a global scale. After rounds of hard negotiations, the World Trade Organization (WTO) adopted the Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies (AFS) on June 17, 2022. This agreement came into force on September 15, 2025. It aims to promote ocean sustainability by prohibiting harmful fisheries subsidies. Recognizing the factual constraints and development needs of some developing country Members, the AFS provides Special and Differential Treatment (SDT) for them. According to Article 7 of the AFS, the WTO established a Fisheries Funding Mechanism to provide developing and least developed country (LDC) Members with targeted technical assistance and capacity building for the purpose of implementing the disciplines under the Agreement. By normative analysis and interdisciplinary approach, this study reviews this Funding Mechanism and determines potential operational challenges, including unpredictable financing, administrative and technical access barriers, vague prioritization and allocation procedures, monitoring, evaluation and learning gaps, and coordination risks. It further proposes certain refinements to enhance transparency, access, and long-term effectiveness. These include clearer prioritization criteria, simplified application procedures, more reliable funding sources, and stronger monitoring and coordination frameworks. A well-functioning assistance system will offer technical and financial aid to support countries in need, enable them to build their national capacity, therefore better complying with the fisheries subsidy disciplines while ensuring their sufficient development space, ultimately helping to achieve the goal of marine sustainable development.
papers.summary_cn: 本文评析WTO《渔业补贴协定》（AFS）下的渔业资助机制，该协定于2025年9月15日生效，通过禁止有害渔业补贴促进海洋可持续性，并为发展中国家和最不发达国家成员提供特殊与差别待遇（SDT）。研究采用规范分析与跨学科方法，识别该机制面临的潜在运行挑战，包括资金来源不可预测、行政与技术准入障碍、优先次序和分配程序模糊、监测评估与学习缺口及协调风险。文章提出明确优先标准、简化申请程序、拓宽可靠资金来源和强化监测协调框架等改进建议，以提升透明度、可及性与长期有效性，帮助有需求国家建设能力、遵守补贴纪律并实现海洋可持续发展目标。

papers.title: Connecting and coordinating fisheries projects to advance problem solving: Using the SCAALE (Strategic Connections Applied Across Leveraged Evaluations) framework
papers.authors: Hitchman, Sean M; Mather, Martha E; Oliver, Devon C; DeVries, Dennis R; Krogman, Rebecca M; Smith, Joseph M; Loubere, Alex D; Conroy, Joseph D; Carey, Michael P; Pope, Kevin L
papers.abstract: Abstract A persistent challenge in fisheries is that field data sets from related studies are often difficult to compare and extend across years and systems. Examples include (1) surveys of native or invasive organisms conducted in one watershed may not predict trends in another watershed; (2) fish stocking protocols that result in high survival in one year may not produce the same results in subsequent years; and (3) data from single-period, single-location creel surveys may not represent angler attitudes, reactions, or preferences in other systems at other times. In our Strategic Connections Applied Across Leveraged Evaluations (SCAALE) framework, we develop a general model to address the knowledge gaps of how to better link related data sets, coordinate relevant perspectives, and merge individual data streams across years, systems, and taxa. We apply SCAALE to three case studies and show an example of the framework for fisheries agency planning. Whereas some external barriers to multi-study strategic planning can be modified through professional resolve (e.g., lack of training in strategic project planning), other barriers may require more extensive discussions (e.g., how funding is allocated). The SCAALE framework provides a relevant and practical approach that manager–researcher–administrator teams could use to advance data syntheses across years, systems, species, and projects. Our perspective initiates this profession-wide conversation.
papers.summary_cn: 针对渔业研究中相关数据集跨年份、跨系统难以比较和整合的问题，提出SCAALE（Strategic Connections Applied Across Leveraged Evaluations）框架，旨在链接相关数据集、协调各方视角并整合跨年份、系统和类群的独立数据流。通过三个案例研究展示该框架的应用，并给出渔业机构规划示例。研究指出部分多研究战略规划的外部障碍可通过专业决心克服（如战略项目规划培训不足），其他障碍（如资金分配方式）则需更广泛讨论。该框架为管理者—研究者—行政人员团队推进跨年份、系统、物种和项目的数据综合提供了实用方法。

papers.title: Fish helminth fauna of the Debed River  of the Lori Region of Armenia
papers.authors: Hovhannisyan, R. L.; Shcherbakov, O V.; Vardanyan, M. V.; Rukhkyan, M. Ya.
papers.abstract: The study of the fish helminth fauna of the Debed Rive rand the detection of fish infection by helminths. The material was collected in 2023. A total of 92 individuals of 4 fish species from the Debed River were examined. Helminthological examination of fish, collection and cameral processing of helminths were carried out according to generally accepted methods. Statistical processing of the results was carried out using the "vassarstats.net" online software. The work was performed at the Scientific Centre of Zoology and Hydroecology, National Academy of Sciences, Republic of Armenia. Six species of helminths were detected in the examined fish examined from the Debed River, including 1 species of trematodes, 2 species of cestodes, 2 species of nematodes and 1 species of acanthocephalans. The total infection of fish by helminths was 51 %. Quantitative characteristics of fish infection by helminths have been determined. A higher infection of fish was observed by metacercariae of the trematode Diplostomum sp. (40.9 %), cestode Schyzocotyle acheilognathi (25.0 %) and plerocercoids of cestode Ligula intestinalis (15.0 %). Metacercariae of the trematode Diplostomum sp. were found in the lenses of all fish species. A greater number of the helminth species discovered in khramicarp. A brief information on fish infection by detected helminths is given. The helminth fauna of fish in the Debed River is characterised by poor species diversity. The formation of the species composition of fish helminths and changes in the infection of fish by helminths depend on the degree and nature of the complex impact of various environmental factors in the study area, both natural and anthropogenic. The most pathogenic species of helminths for fish were identified. They are the causative agents of ligulosis and diplostomosis, causing significant harm to the fish and often leading to their death.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究调查了亚美尼亚洛里地区Debed河鱼类的蠕虫区系及感染情况，于2023年采集4种92尾鱼，按标准寄生虫学方法进行检查。共检出6种蠕虫（1种吸虫、2种绦虫、2种线虫、1种棘头虫），总感染率为51%；以Diplostomum sp.囊蚴（40.9%）、Schyzocotyle acheilognathi（25.0%）和Ligula intestinalis裂头蚴（15.0%）感染率较高，Diplostomum sp.囊蚴见于所有鱼种的眼晶状体。该河鱼类蠕虫区系物种多样性较低，其组成和感染变化受自然与人为环境因素综合影响；Ligula intestinalis和Diplostomum sp.为致病性最强的种类，可造成显著危害甚至死亡。

papers.title: Postbiotics as Regulators of Gene Expression and Enzymatic Activity in Fish and Shellfish: Implications for Growth, Immunity, and Reproduction
papers.authors: Ahmadifar, Ehsan; Khanzadeh, Majid; Hosseini, Saeedeh; Chandran, Deepak; Abdul Kalam Saleena, Lejaniya; Soo Oi Yoona, Michelle
papers.abstract: Postbiotics, a novel class of non-viable probiotic-derived feed additives, are emerging as a promising, sustainable alternative to antibiotics and live probiotics in aquaculture. Comprising inactivated microbial cells, cell wall components, and microbial metabolites (e.g., cell-free supernatants, short-chain fatty acids, and bacteriocins), postbiotics have been shown in laboratory and animal studies to enhance growth, modulate immune responses, improve gut health and microbiome balance, and increase disease resistance in fish and shellfish. Compared with live microbes, postbiotics offer greater physicochemical stability and lower risk of transferring antimicrobial-resistance genes, which improves their suitability for farm applications. Nevertheless, significant limitations remain: lack of standardized production and dosing protocols, incomplete understanding of cellular and systemic mechanisms of action, scarce species- and life-stage-specific efficacy data, and a shortage of long-term environmental and field evaluations. This review synthesizes current preparation methods, active components, and evidence of biological activity for postbiotics, identifies key research gaps, and highlights priorities such as diversified formulations, exploration of synergistic combinations with other feed additives, standardization of experimental approaches, and expanded field trials to bridge laboratory findings with practical aquaculture use.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦后生元（postbiotics）作为水产养殖中替代抗生素和活益生菌的新型非活性饲料添加剂，系统梳理了其制备方法、活性成分（灭活菌体、细胞壁组分、无细胞上清、短链脂肪酸、细菌素等）及在鱼贝类中促进生长、调节免疫、改善肠道菌群和增强抗病力的生物学证据。与活菌相比，后生元理化稳定性更高且耐药基因转移风险更低，更适于养殖应用。但当前仍存在生产与给药方案缺乏标准化、作用机制认识不足、物种及生活史阶段特异性数据稀缺、长期环境与田间评估缺乏等局限，作者据此提出剂型多样化、与其他饲料添加剂协同组合、实验方法标准化及扩大田间试验等优先研究方向。

papers.title: Edible insect-based feed ingredients as modulators of gastrointestinal physiology in monogastric livestock and aquaculture species
papers.authors: Sánchez-Velázquez, Oscar Abel; Hernández-Álvarez, Alan Javier
papers.abstract: Edible insects have emerged as promising sustainable feed ingredients capable of supporting both animal production and gastrointestinal health. Beyond their nutritional value, insect-derived meals contain bioactive compounds—including chitin, antimicrobial peptides, medium-chain fatty acids, micronutrients, and antioxidant molecules—that may modulate gut microbiota–host interactions in farmed monogastric animal species. This review critically examines current evidence on the mechanisms through which insect-based diets influence gastrointestinal physiology in livestock and aquaculture species. Available studies indicate that dietary insect inclusion can promote beneficial shifts in gut microbial communities, including increased bacterial diversity, enrichment of short-chain fatty acid-producing taxa, and reductions in selected opportunistic pathogens. However, these responses are not uniform across experimental models and depend on factors including insect species, processing method, dietary inclusion level, host species, age, and physiological status. Rather than acting through isolated mechanisms, insect-derived bioactive compounds function as an integrated nutritional matrix that simultaneously influences microbial metabolism, epithelial signaling, and immune regulation. Future standardized and multi-omics studies will be essential to identify the principal bioactive compounds responsible for these physiological effects and to optimize insect-derived functional ingredients for precision animal nutrition and more sustainable livestock and aquaculture production.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述食用昆虫作为可持续饲料原料对单胃家畜和水产养殖动物胃肠道生理的调控作用。昆虫源饲料中的几丁质、抗菌肽、中链脂肪酸及抗氧化物质等生物活性成分可调节肠道微生物与宿主互作，现有研究表明日粮添加昆虫可提高肠道菌群多样性、富集产短链脂肪酸菌群并抑制部分条件致病菌。这些效应受昆虫种类、加工方式、添加水平及宿主种类和生理状态影响，并非单一机制介导。未来需通过标准化和多组学研究鉴定关键活性成分，以优化昆虫源功能性饲料原料在精准动物营养和可持续养殖中的应用。

papers.title: Evaluating the influences of fishmeal replacement on growth, immune and nutritional performance in aquaculture
papers.authors: Faseeha, Inshrah; Khaliq, Aiza; Hamid, Majid; Mubeen, Noor e
papers.abstract: Aquaculture serves as an auspicious protein source for the human consumption. To cultivate aquatic organism proficiently, the prepared feed should have eminence protein constituents. Feed for aquatic animals contain raw fish as a main product e.g fish oil and fishmeal that gained from the whole fish and its remains. The fish silage is feasible for using in feed after their bioconversion or transformation. Feed for aquatic animals includes raw fish as a primary ingredient, such as fish oil and fishmeal obtained from whole fish and their by-products. Fish silage can be used in feed after undergoing bioconversion or processing. This impending ingredient is the main cost effective component of the whole feed of fish. In this review we discuss the alternative protein sources in the fish feed based on plant or animal, that can reduce the budget and improved the fish efficacy, effective for the sustainability of aquaculture for low to high scale farming. Production of aquaculture inflates worldwide to meet the demand of world for protein (fish, seafood etc.). Hence, investigation on low cost substitute protein sources of fishmeal was prolific, provide good information that could be helpful for the small fish farmers.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了水产饲料中鱼粉替代蛋白源（植物源或动物源）对鱼类生长、免疫及营养性能的影响，旨在降低饲料成本并提升养殖效益。鱼粉和鱼油作为水产饲料的主要成分成本较高，鱼青贮等生物转化产物可作为潜在替代原料。综述指出，低成本替代蛋白源的研究可为小规模养殖户提供有价值的信息，有助于水产养殖的可持续性发展。

papers.title: Paralytic shellfish toxin production in Alexandrium minutum (Dinophyceae): Insights from omics integration using toxigenic and nontoxigenic recombinant progeny
papers.authors: Mary, Lou; Quere, Julien; Latimier, Marie; Artigaud, Sébastien; Hégaret, Hélène; Le Gac, Mickael; Réveillon, Damien
papers.abstract: Abstract Paralytic shellfish toxins (PSTs) are produced by certain species of cyanobacteria and dinoflagellates. Part of the PST biosynthetic pathway has been elucidated in cyanobacteria, and the implication of some sxt genes has been confirmed by experimental studies. Contrary to cyanobacteria, knowledge about PST biosynthesis in dinoflagellates is more limited and generally restricted to comparative studies with the cyanobacterial pathway. To investigate the specificity of the PST pathway in dinoflagellates, 16 toxigenic and nontoxigenic Alexandrium minutum strains from a recombinant cross were compared, without prior assumption about genes or metabolites involved in PST synthesis, using an integrative approach combining untargeted metabolomic and transcriptomic data. Among the 60 most distinguishing transcripts between toxigenic and non‐toxigenic strains, only three sxt genes were present: sxt A4, sxt G, and sxt I. In contrast, non‐ sxt homologs were detected as highly discriminant between these two phenotypes. More specifically, a phy H homolog may act as the analog of the sxt S gene observed in cyanobacteria. Moreover, we identified four putative synthetic PST intermediates. Among these, Int‐C'2 correlated with the toxic phenotype, whereas three others were detected in both toxigenic and nontoxigenic strains, suggesting that these strains may share some parts of the biosynthetic pathway. Finally, our analyses identified both horizontally gained sxt genes and endogenous genes, including the candidate gene phy H, as candidate components of the PST biosynthetic pathway in A. minutum .
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过整合非靶向代谢组学与转录组学数据，比较了16株产毒与非产毒重组子代亚历山大藻（*Alexandrium minutum*）菌株，在未预设PST合成相关基因或代谢物的情况下探究甲藻中麻痹性贝类毒素（PST）合成途径的特异性。在60个最具判别力的转录本中仅发现3个sxt基因（sxt A4、sxt G、sxt I），而非sxt同源基因（尤其是phy H同源基因，可能为蓝藻sxt S的功能类似物）在两种表型间判别力更强。研究鉴定出4种推定PST合成中间体，其中Int-C'2与产毒表型相关，其余3种在两种菌株中均存在，提示二者可能共享部分合成途径。结果表明*A. minutum*的PST合成途径由水平获得的sxt基因与内源基因（包括候选基因phy H）共同组成。
