papers.title: Government Support for Small Scale Aquaculture
papers.authors: Dhall, Reeth
papers.abstract: Aquaculture policy must reconcile rising food demand with ecological limits and equitable livelihoods. This narrative review examines whether governments should prioritise small-scale producers when allocating public support. It draws on international production statistics, comparative environmental research, a Bangladesh producer study, evidence on rice–fish integration and Indian policy documents. The evidence supports targeted assistance where finance, information or shared infrastructure constrain viable small-scale production. It does not support treating farm size as a reliable proxy for sustainability. Commercial production can improve food access, while small farms can also contribute to pollution and disease risks. A policy framework is proposed that combines accessible extension services, shared facilities and carefully tested risk protection with environmental conditions applying across scales. Public programmes should be evaluated through additional gains in income, food access, and environmental performance, rather than output or expenditure alone.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述探讨政府在水产养殖公共支持分配中是否应优先小规模生产者，综合国际生产统计、环境比较研究、孟加拉国生产者调查、稻鱼共作证据及印度政策文件。证据支持在金融、信息或共享基础设施制约可行小规模生产时提供定向援助，但不支持将养殖规模作为可持续性的可靠代理指标。商业生产可改善食物获取，小农场同样可能带来污染与病害风险。作者提出结合推广服务、共享设施、经审慎测试的风险保护及跨规模环境条件的政策框架，并主张以收入、食物获取和环境绩效的增量收益而非产出或支出评估公共项目。

papers.title: Marine heatwave exposure is changing unevenly across Scottish aquaculture sites
papers.authors: Toledo-Jaime, Camila; Graham, Jennifer; Hudson, Ben; Moffat, David; Townhill, Bryony; Palmer, Steven
papers.abstract: Introduction Marine heatwaves (MHWs) are an increasing climate hazard for coastal aquaculture, yet regional assessments may not resolve how exposure varies across the locations where farms operate. Methods Here, we analysed daily ~5-km OSTIA sea surface temperature data from 1990 to 2025 at the locations of 361 active Scottish finfish and shellfish farms, represented by 218 unique grid cells, and compared satellite temperatures with in situ records from eight farms. We used principal component analysis and hierarchical clustering to describe long-term MHW exposure, and mixed-effects models to assess temporal changes. Results Two broad exposure profiles were identified. Cluster 1 was characterised by higher mean, maximum and cumulative intensity, whereas differences in event duration and frequency between clusters were smaller. Temporal trends, however, differed more strongly. MHW frequency increased at similar rates in both clusters, while event duration, cumulative intensity and severity increased more rapidly in Cluster 2. Between 1990 -2019 and 2020 -2025, estimated event duration increased by 44.6% in Cluster 1 and 89.9% in Cluster 2, while cumulative intensity increased by 50.0% and approximately 127.5%, respectively (cluster × period, p &lt; 0.001). The estimated probability of a Severe or Extreme event rose from 2.2% to 26.2% in Cluster 2, compared with 1.8% to 6.1% in Cluster 1 (cluster × period, p &lt; 0.001). Mean event intensity changed comparatively little. Discussion These findings show that MHW exposure across Scottish aquaculture is multidimensional, spatially uneven and changing at different rates through time. The resulting hazard -exposure landscape helps bridge regional MHW assessments and individual-farm monitoring, providing a foundation for more targeted monitoring and future assessment of aquaculture vulnerability and climate risk.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于1990–2025年约5 km分辨率的OSTIA海表温度数据，分析了苏格兰361个活跃鱼类和贝类养殖场（218个网格单元）的marine heatwave（MHW）暴露特征，并与8个养殖场的现场记录进行比对。通过主成分分析和层次聚类识别出两类暴露剖面，并利用混合效应模型评估其时间变化。结果显示，Cluster 1以较高的平均、最大和累积强度为特征，而Cluster 2的事件持续时间、累积强度和严重程度增长更快：1990–2019年至2020–2025年间，持续时间分别增加44.6%和89.9%，累积强度分别增加50.0%和约127.5%；Cluster 2发生Severe或Extreme事件的概率从2.2%升至26.2%，远高于Cluster 1的1.8%至6.1%。研究表明苏格兰水产养殖的MHW暴露具有多维性、空间不均衡性和差异化时间变化趋势，为针对性监测和养殖脆弱性评估提供了基础。

papers.title: Ecology drives the degree of convergence in the gene expression of extremophile fishes
papers.authors: Tobler, Michael; Greenway, Ryan; Kelley, Joanna L.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the Royal Society B: Biological Sciences
papers.abstract: Abstract Convergent evolution is common and a testament to the repeatability of evolution. Still, non-convergence is also widespread, and a major question is whether idiosyncratic, lineage-specific changes are reflective of chance events inherent to evolutionary processes, or whether they are influenced by deterministic genetic or ecological factors. To address this question, we quantified the degree of convergence in gene expression across lineages of livebearing fishes (Poeciliidae) that span 40 million years of divergence and have colonized toxic, hydrogen-sulfide-rich springs. We asked whether the degree of convergence across lineage pairs was related to their phylogenetic relatedness and the ecological similarity of their habitats. Using phylogenetic comparative analyses, we showed that the degree of convergence in gene expression was variable across lineage pairs. While closely related lineages did not exhibit higher degrees of convergence than distantly related ones, we uncovered a strong relationship between degree of convergence and the ecological similarity among lineages. These results suggest that variation in environmental conditions that is often overlooked in simplified descriptions of habitat differences can play an important role in shaping adaptive evolution. Our study highlights the importance of multivariate approaches that capture the complexities of selective regimes and organismal responses when assessing the repeatability of evolution.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以跨约4000万年分化的卵胎生鱼类（Poeciliidae）为对象，量化其独立定殖富含硫化氢有毒泉水的多个谱系间基因表达趋同程度，检验趋同程度是否与系统发育亲缘关系及栖息地生态相似性相关。系统发育比较分析表明，基因表达趋同程度在各谱系对间存在差异，近缘谱系并未表现出比远缘谱系更高的趋同性，但趋同程度与谱系间生态相似性呈强相关。结果表明，常被简化栖息地差异描述所忽略的环境条件多维变异在塑造适应性进化中具有重要作用，强调在评估进化可重复性时需采用多变量方法刻画选择压力与生物响应的复杂性。

papers.title: Cross-domain risk governance of transboundary marine policies for blue carbon ecosystem protection: a fuzzy AHP evaluation framework applied to the nuclear wastewater discharge case
papers.authors: Huang, WeiLun
papers.abstract: Introduction Blue carbon ecosystems sequester carbon at rates that dwarf most terrestrial forests yet occupy less than 0.5% of the global ocean surface, making their protection under transboundary marine policy shocks both ecologically imperative and analytically underserved. Unilateral marine policy decisions in one coastal state, whether discharging pollutants, restructuring fishery regimes, or altering spatial zoning, generate externalities that propagate simultaneously across political, economic, industrial, and environmental channels into the blue carbon systems of neighboring states. No existing risk assessment tool captures this cross-domain, transjurisdictional character in a single integrated procedure. Methods This study develops and applies a Cross-Domain Risk Management Procedure (CDRMP) calibrated explicitly to blue carbon governance contexts. Grounded in polycentric governance theory, ecosystem services economics, and a transboundary externality model, the CDRMP framework embeds 36 evaluation criteria constructed via Nominal Group Technique and weighted via Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) across 114 respondents from government, industry, and public constituencies. The framework is applied to Japan's Fukushima Daiichi nuclear wastewater discharge into the Pacific Ocean as an illustrative transboundary case. Results Three principal findings emerge. First, geopolitical contestation (weight 0.197) nearly matches direct environmental contamination (0.206) in CDRMP severity, indicating that political governance instability and ecological contamination are mutually reinforcing rather than sequential risk events. Second, five of the seven highest-ranked criteria are blue-carbon-relevant, three of them blue-carbon-specific additions introduced by the ecological extension of the standard environmental domain, suggesting that frameworks without such calibration may systematically underdetect the most severe governance risks. Third, policy evaluation under optimistic, pessimistic, and equal-probabilities decision criteria shows no single policy dominating across all rules and analytical levels: marine environmental policy is preferred under two of three criteria at the dimension level and attains the single lowest aggregate deviation observed (0.856 under equal-probabilities), marine spatial policy is preferred under the pessimistic criterion at both levels, and marine economic policy is preferred under the optimistic criterion at the criterion level. Discussion The contingent pattern of policy preference is consistent with, though not a direct test of, complementary rather than substitutable governance roles across environmental, spatial, and economic instruments. The study contributes the first quantitatively operational CDRMP framework to the literatures on polycentric governance, blue carbon ecosystem services, and multi-criteria marine policy evaluation, providing coastal states with a replicable assessment procedure for transboundary marine policy risks.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究构建了跨域风险管理程序（CDRMP），基于多中心治理理论、生态系统服务经济学与跨境外部性模型，通过名义群体技术确定36项评价标准，并运用模糊层次分析法（FAHP）对来自政府、产业与公众的114名受访者进行权重赋值，以日本福岛第一核电站核废水排海为案例评估跨境海洋政策风险。结果显示，地缘政治争议（权重0.197）与直接环境污染（0.206）的风险严重性几乎相当，表明政治治理不稳定与生态污染相互强化而非序贯发生；7项最高排名标准中有5项与蓝碳相关，提示未经蓝碳校准的框架可能系统性低估最严重的治理风险。在乐观、悲观与等概率三种决策准则下无单一政策始终占优：海洋环境政策在维度层三项准则中的两项下最优（等概率下聚合偏差最低为0.856），海洋空间政策在悲观准则下两级均最优，海洋经济政策在准则层乐观准则下最优。

papers.title: Transoceanic migration of a female tiger shark (Galeocerdo cuvier) demonstrates connectivity in the southern Atlantic
papers.authors: Ostrovski, Raquel L.; Cochran, Jesse E. M.; Rangel, Bianca S.; Richardson, Eloise B.; Rodrigues, Alexandre; Santander-Neto, Jones; Jones, Burton H.; Moreira, Renata G.; Gomes, Fernando R.; Berumen, Michael L.
papers.abstract: Abstract The tiger shark is a highly migratory apex predator with distinct populations in the Atlantic and Indo-Pacific regions. Regional analyses in the western Atlantic Ocean have revealed additional genetic differentiation between northern (Caribbean) and southern (Brazilian) populations, particularly in maternally inherited mitochondrial DNA. The eastern Atlantic Ocean, however, remains understudied, leaving connectivity between American and African populations unresolved. Using a fin-mounted satellite transmitter, we document the complete eastward transatlantic movement of a female tiger shark (2.9 m total length), tracked from Fernando de Noronha Archipelago, Brazil, to the coastal waters of Sierra Leone, West Africa. Following an initial prolonged residency of around Fernando de Noronha, the individual undertook a 6,764 km migration across the Atlantic over 116 days (mean ~58 km day -1 ). Surfacing behavior differed significantly between the residency and migration phases, shifting from predominantly nocturnal to predominantly diurnal detections. This movement corroborates previous findings that female tiger sharks can disperse across basin scales and suggests that equatorial migration may facilitate genetic connectivity between the western and eastern Atlantic. In the absence of genetic data from West Africa, the demographic and genetic consequences of such movements remain undetermined, underscoring the need to integrate telemetry with expanded population genetic sampling to better understand connectivity in highly mobile marine predators.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用鳍载卫星发射器追踪一条雌性虎鲨（Galeocerdo cuvier，全长2.9 m）从巴西Fernando de Noronha群岛迁至西非塞拉利昂沿海，完成6,764 km跨大西洋迁移，历时116天（日均约58 km）。该个体在迁出前于群岛附近长时间停留，迁移期间水面活动节律由夜行性转为昼行性。结果证实雌性虎鲨可跨洋盆扩散，提示赤道迁移可能促进西大西洋与东大西洋种群间的遗传连通性；但西非缺乏遗传数据，其种群与遗传后果仍待结合telemetry与扩展种群遗传采样进一步评估。

papers.title: Within‐lake length adjustment improves otolith shape discrimination among lake trout Salvelinus namaycush populations
papers.authors: Howell, Bradley E.; Navarroli, Giulio; Mullen, Eric J.; Morissette, Olivier; Hasler, Caleb T.
papers.abstract: Abstract Distinguishing fish populations is a long‐standing challenge in fisheries management, and otolith shape provides a low‐cost marker of population structure. Fish size strongly influences otolith shape; however, within‐lake size variation can obscure differences among populations. Here, a within‐lake length adjustment of otolith elliptic Fourier descriptors increased the otolith shape differences detected among three populations of Manitoban lake trout Salvelinus namaycush ( n = 153). The adjustment estimated and removed the relationship between each descriptor and fish total length within each population while retaining that population's mean shape. Lake of origin explained 3.2% of otolith shape variation before adjustment and 4.9% after, and all three pairs of lakes differed significantly after adjustment compared with one of three before. Classification assigned fish to the three lakes more evenly after adjustment, with correct assignment of Second Cranberry Lake fish rising from 13% to 34%. The within‐lake adjustment recovered more of the shape variation among lakes than the shapeR package while keeping all 28 Fourier coefficients. Reconstructed mean outlines identified Clearwater Lake otoliths as the most distinctive, carrying a more pronounced rostrum than the two other lakes. Despite a shared stocking history among the three lakes, otolith shape still differed among them, consistent with growth environment as a source of these differences. The within‐lake length adjustment provides a low‐cost description of population structure for inland fisheries that rely on archived otolith material.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在评估湖内体长校正对提高湖鳟（Salvelinus namaycush）种群耳石形状判别力的效果。对马尼托巴省三个湖泊共153尾湖鳟的耳石椭圆傅里叶描述子进行湖内体长校正，即在各种群内估计并剔除各描述子与体长的关系，同时保留种群平均形状。校正后湖泊来源解释的耳石形状变异由3.2%升至4.9%，三对湖泊间均呈显著差异（校正前仅一对显著），Second Cranberry Lake的正确判别率由13%升至34%。该方法较shapeR包保留更多湖泊间形状变异且保留全部28个傅里叶系数，为依赖存档耳石的内陆渔业种群结构评估提供了低成本手段。
